groups.DGIdb_other: DGIdb interaction type from every other claim source (ChEMBL claims v33, DTC, TTD, ...); identity as served
groups.GtoPdb: DGIdb rows whose claim source is GuideToPharmacology (target verified or corrected through GtoPdb ids), i.e. GtoPdb action as carried by the catalogue

Mnet_by_source_group.independence_note: the groups are NOT independent votes: DGIdb carries ChEMBL (v33) and GtoPdb claims, and GtoPdb curates some of the same drugs as ChEMBL; the overlap shows redundancy, not replication

definitions.L1: record has at least one target row (ChEMBL curated mechanism or DGIdb interaction)
definitions.L2: (documented action as the source states it, NOT necessarily a pharmacological modulation: it admits 37 ChEMBL OTHER rows and classes such as vaccine antigen, exogenous protein/gene, releasing/sequestering/chelating/cross-linking agent) at least one row with a STATED action (ChEMBL action_type present; DGIdb interaction_type present and not other/unknown and not a source conflict) that passes the catalogue artefact rules of repurposing_search.artefact_reason (unconfirmed identity, source artefacts, alias risk) and a non-placeholder name
definitions.L3_Mnet: L2 row whose action maps to a SIGN (down: inhibitor, antagonist, blocker, negative modulators, inverse agonist, degrader...; up: agonist, activator, positive modulators, opener, potentiator...) on a human target with a stable identifier (ChEMBL: Homo sapiens + target id + UniProt; DGIdb: HGNC concept id). Sign is the source's effect on the TARGET's activity; modulator/binding agent/antibody/unstated are not signed
definitions.Msig_any: the record's InChIKey first block (connectivity layer, the catalogue's own family key) equals the first block of a LINCS compound perturbagen that has at least one trt_cp signature in GSE92742 or GSE70138
definitions.Msig_neural_extended: strict plus FIBRNPC (cell_info gives no modification text and primary_site skin: lineage UNKNOWN, kept apart)
definitions.Msig_neural_strict: as Msig_any, with at least one signature in a cell id of: NPC, NPC.CAS9, NPC.TAK, NEU, NEU.KCL, MNEU.E (neural-lineage cells as cell_info describes them: NPC, NPC.CAS9 (Cas9-engineered) and NPC.TAK are iPSC-derived progenitors with primary_site central nervous system; NEU has no recorded origin beyond 'terminally differentiated to be neurons'; MNEU.E is embryonic-stem-cell-derived motor neurons; NEU.KCL is KCl-stimulated NEU and has 0 compound signatures). Genotype UNKNOWN, no WWOX perturbation documented
definitions.actually_evaluated: 0: no compound has been scored or ranked by either method; usable is an input requirement, not a result

eu_registers.country_or_jurisdiction: European Union level (not Italy or any national list)
eu_registers.reference: catalog/README.md, section 'European context probe, IT5 P10'
eu_registers.scope: name-match probes only (catalog/eu_context_probe.tsv, one row per probe string), not a catalogue-wide field: no catalogue record carries an EU access category
eu_registers.source: EU Open Data Portal datasets of DG SANTE: EU register of nutrition and health claims, EU Novel Food status catalogue

families.overlap_note: 'neither' over the full denominator contains the UNKNOWN_NO_STRUCTURE_KEY group, whose M-sig state is unknown, not negative; the *_testable_only overlaps use only records (families) with a structure key

records.overlap_note: 'neither' over the full denominator contains the UNKNOWN_NO_STRUCTURE_KEY group, whose M-sig state is unknown, not negative; the *_testable_only overlaps use only records (families) with a structure key

lincs.ASC_note: ASC / ASC.C in cell_info are adipose-derived stem cells (primary_site adipose), NOT astrocytes; no glial compound context is counted

series.GSE70138: phase II (Broad LINCS L1000 expansion, deposited 2017); counted the same way
series.GSE92742: phase I (Broad LINCS L1000, deposited 2017); compound signatures counted here as sig_info rows with pert_type trt_cp

match_rule_sensitivity.name_equality_probe_not_used: the independent verifier found 2,001 of the families without a structure key whose name equals a LINCS compound name; name matching is not used here (identity unresolved)
match_rule_sensitivity.note: name matching is not used; source-only records without a structure are in the denominator and cannot be counted usable by M-sig (UNKNOWN, not negative)

pilot.definition: families usable by BOTH M-net and M-sig (neural strict) union the families linked to a curated card (card_links.json)

units.compound: in this census a compound is a family; the record counts are given beside
units.families: ChEMBL parent/child or identical InChIKey first block, plus the 485 source-only records joined by GtoPdb ligand reconciliation; every other source-only record is its own family (identity unresolved, never merged on name)
units.records: source-level substance records (a salt, a stereoisomer and a source-only row each count once)
